hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A contiguous range xor product can be expressed as the xor difference of two prefix values.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Store binary representations of prefix xor values in a bitwise branching retrieval structure.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: To find the best companion prefix, traverse opposite bits from most significant to least significant.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix differences are checked against upper bounds in O(n^2) worst case.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
